title: The Runaways
html:
Somebody left the paddock gate unlatched overnight and three of the Stablemaster's horses bolted. They won't have gone far, and they won't come back on their own either.

About

Given byStablemaster
Level10
LengthMedium
KindMount & companion
Quest points2

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Stablemaster (outdoors near Binxonia) to get the quest.
  2. Send the three horses home:
    Black horse, in the Binxonian Woodlands - a short ride from the Stablemaster, on the way to the Binxonia Iron Mine
    Brown horse, in the Western Binxonian Woodlands - a short walk from where an Underleaf teleport scroll drops you
    White horse, on the Longmeadow Plains - right next to where an Appleseed Farm teleport scroll drops you
  3. Return to the Stablemaster in Binxonia to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold200
Character XP9,000
Quest points2
Unlocksa pack mule

What Stablemaster says

Stablemaster: There's the black one coming up the lane now, mud to the shoulder and pleased with himself.

Stablemaster: I keep my word. The gray mule in the end stall is yours: sound feet, honest back, and she'll carry whatever you strap to her.

Stablemaster: Whistle her up whenever you like. And mind the gate on your way out.

Handing it in

"All three home, and not a scratch on them. The gray mule in the end stall is yours."
